mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ocr_job WHERE document_id=#{documentId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM ocr_job WHERE document_id=#{documentId} AND provider_mode=#{mode} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ocr_job j JOIN document d ON d.id=j.document_id JOIN application a ON a.id=d.application_id WHERE a.workspace_id=#{workspaceId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ocr_job j JOIN document d ON d.id=j.document_id JOIN application a ON a.id=d.application_id WHERE a.workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND a.owner_id=#{ownerId} AND j.created_at >= UTC_DATE()

SELECT j.* FROM ocr_job j JOIN document d ON d.id=j.document_id JOIN application a ON a.id=d.application_id JOIN workspace w ON w.id=a.workspace_id WHERE (w.kind='NORMAL' OR w.expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) AND j.attempts<3 AND ((j.status='PENDING' AND j.next_attempt_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) OR (j.status='RUNNING' AND j.lease_until<UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND j.provider_mode!='LIVE_AI')) ORDER BY j.id LIMIT 3
mapper.update: UPDATE ocr_job SET status='RUNNING',attempts=attempts+1,claim_token=#{token},lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,240,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE id=#{id} AND attempts<3 AND ((status='PENDING' AND next_attempt_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) OR (status='RUNNING' AND lease_until<UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND provider_mode!='LIVE_AI'))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ocr_result(job_id,extracted_fields,evidence,raw_result) VALUES(#{jobId},#{fields},#{evidence},#{raw}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE job_id=VALUES(job_id)

'FAILED'
,error_code=#{code},lease_until=NULL,next_attempt_at=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,5,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE id=#{id} AND claim_token=#{token} AND status='RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT r.* FROM ocr_result r JOIN ocr_job j ON j.id=r.job_id WHERE j.document_id=#{documentId} AND j.id=(SELECT MAX(latest.id) FROM ocr_job latest WHERE latest.document_id=#{documentId}) AND j.status='SUCCEEDED' ORDER BY j.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT field_code,confirmed_value FROM field_confirmation WHERE document_id=#{documentId} ORDER BY field_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO field_confirmation(document_id,ocr_result_id,field_code,confirmed_value,confirmed_by) VALUES(#{documentId},#{resultId},#{field},#{value},#{actorId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ocr_result_id=VALUES(ocr_result_id),confirmed_value=VALUES(confirmed_value),confirmed_by=VALUES(confirmed_by),confirmed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.select: SELECT s.code FROM application a JOIN workspace w ON w.id=a.workspace_id LEFT JOIN demo_scenario s ON s.id=w.scenario_id WHERE a.id=#{applicationId}
mapper.update: UPDATE ocr_job SET status='FAILED', error_code='LEASE_EXPIRED', lease_until=NULL WHERE status='RUNNING' AND (attempts >= 3 OR provider_mode='LIVE_AI') AND lease_until < UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_daily_usage(usage_day,scope_key) VALUES(UTC_DATE(),#{scope}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE scope_key=VALUES(scope_key)
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_daily_usage SET requests=requests+1 WHERE usage_day=UTC_DATE() AND scope_key=#{scope} AND requests < #{limit}
